headline: President Obama signed an order changing an earlier executive order, Executive Order 13390.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13390, which was issued earlier. The title alone does not say what the earlier order covers or what changes this order makes. Without more information, its specific effects cannot be described.
when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, September 29, 2009, though the source does not say.
